headline: Lock Haven beat Gannon and close in at the top
dek: Lock Haven beat Gannon on Lock Haven's ground, turning round the first meeting between the sides, and Gannon go into the final day with Lock Haven, West Chester and Millersville close behind. Gannon have won eleven, drawn three and lost three, with Slippery Rock and now Lock Haven both beating them this month.
displaced_by: Lock Haven beat Gannon; the standing dek's record of two defeats is no longer true.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Gannon have scored more than California (Pa.) and Shippensburg together and conceded 22, so the tallest bar stands on attack: theirs is a lead in goals scored, not in goals kept out.

wire.line: Lock Haven, West Chester and Millersville can each still finish level with Gannon at the top.
